Context: 3. Certain Special Entries.-

- (viii) Entries in the body of the Service Book.Important events, e.g., suspension, reversion as a penalty, confirmation, termination of probation, fixation of pay in revised scale, stepping up of pay, etc., to be entered in the body of the Service Book giving reference to authority. Also specific entry as to whether period(s) of EXOL/Suspension will or will not count as qualifying service for pension should be made.
